reason: A local testing and debugging plugin that audits AI API relays and LLM proxies for prompt injection, model substitution signals, context or tool-call rewriting, stream anomalies, error leakage, and profile-gated wallet-safety behavior, producing reviewable Markdown reports.

summaries.zh: 用于本地审计 AI API 中继和 LLM 代理行为，检测提示注入、模型替换信号、上下文或工具调用改写、流异常及错误泄露，并生成 Markdown 报告。
summaries.en: A local audit tool for AI API relays and LLM proxies that checks prompt injection, model-substitution signals, context or tool-call rewriting, stream anomalies, and error leakage, then produces Markdown reports.

capabilities: Sends supplied API credentials to a user-selected relay endpoint
Probes AI API relay and LLM proxy request and response behavior
Runs optional Web3 and wallet-safety probes without performing wallet transactions
